quarterly_data.quarter: Linde press release: Linde Expands Supply of Industrial Gases to Tata Steel in (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Linde (release): under a long-term supply agreement Linde has doubled its on-site capacity for Tata Steel at the Kalinganagar Industrial Complex in Odisha, India, through the de-captivation of two air separation units now supplying oxygen, nitrogen and argon, which will help Tata Steel raise annual steel production there from three million tons to eight million tons; Linde's total capacity in the Kalinganagar region is now more than seven thousand tons of oxygen per day, also serving the regional merchant market.
quarterly_data.figure: on-site capacity doubled; regional capacity more than seven thousand tons of oxygen per day
